label: TPO point of control (UTC month)
gloss: the price bin holding the most time of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area high (UTC month)
gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area low (UTC month)
gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO point of control (previous UTC month)
gloss: the price bin that held the most time of the previous completed UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area high (previous UTC month)
gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area of the previous completed UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area low (previous UTC month)
gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area of the previous completed UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: High (previous UTC month)
gloss: the high of the previous completed UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

label: Low (previous UTC month)
gloss: the low of the previous completed UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

label: Pivot S3
gloss: the third floor support pivot, the previous UTC day’s low − 2 × (that day’s high − P)

label: Pivot R4
gloss: the fourth floor resistance pivot, 3P + (the previous UTC day’s high − 3 × that day’s low)

label: Pivot R5
gloss: the fifth floor resistance pivot, 4P + (the previous UTC day’s high − 4 × that day’s low)

label: Pivot S4
gloss: the fourth floor support pivot, 3P − (3 × the previous UTC day’s high − that day’s low)

label: Pivot S5
gloss: the fifth floor support pivot, 4P − (4 × the previous UTC day’s high − that day’s low)

label: Fibonacci pivot R1
gloss: the Fibonacci first resistance pivot, P + 0.382 × the previous UTC day’s range

label: Fibonacci pivot R2
gloss: the Fibonacci second resistance pivot, P + 0.618 × the previous UTC day’s range

label: Fibonacci pivot S1
gloss: the Fibonacci first support pivot, P − 0.382 × the previous UTC day’s range

label: Fibonacci pivot S2
gloss: the Fibonacci second support pivot, P − 0.618 × the previous UTC day’s range

label: Classic pivot R3
gloss: the Classic third resistance pivot, P + 2 × the previous UTC day’s range

label: Classic pivot R4
gloss: the Classic fourth resistance pivot, P + 3 × the previous UTC day’s range

label: Classic pivot S3
gloss: the Classic third support pivot, P − 2 × the previous UTC day’s range

label: Classic pivot S4
gloss: the Classic fourth support pivot, P − 3 × the previous UTC day’s range

label: Camarilla pivot R1
gloss: the Camarilla first resistance level, the previous UTC day’s close + 1.1 × that day’s range / 12

label: Camarilla pivot R2
gloss: the Camarilla second resistance level, the previous UTC day’s close + 1.1 × that day’s range / 6

label: Camarilla pivot R3
gloss: the Camarilla third resistance level, the previous UTC day’s close + 1.1 × that day’s range / 4

label: Camarilla pivot R4
gloss: the Camarilla fourth resistance level, the previous UTC day’s close + 1.1 × that day’s range / 2

label: Camarilla pivot R5
gloss: the Camarilla fifth resistance level, (the previous UTC day’s high / its low) × its close

label: Camarilla pivot S1
gloss: the Camarilla first support level, the previous UTC day’s close − 1.1 × that day’s range / 12

label: Camarilla pivot S2
gloss: the Camarilla second support level, the previous UTC day’s close − 1.1 × that day’s range / 6

label: Camarilla pivot S3
gloss: the Camarilla third support level, the previous UTC day’s close − 1.1 × that day’s range / 4

label: Camarilla pivot S4
gloss: the Camarilla fourth support level, the previous UTC day’s close − 1.1 × that day’s range / 2
